changesProposed.name: Y Combinator

verified.name: Y Combinator
verified.thesis: Y Combinator invests $500,000 per company ($125,000 for 7% equity on post-money SAFE and $375,000 on uncapped SAFE with MFN clause) in a select group of startups accepted into four annual batches. The three-month intensive program provides office hours, mentorship, and community support to help startups improve their product, gain users, and prepare for fundraising.
verified.notes: Garry Tan became President and CEO in January 2023. Headquarters moved from Mountain View to San Francisco in spring 2023. Program structure changed to four annual batches with standardized $500K investment as of January 2022.
